secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key with web-search access, used by Find contact (Responses API + the web_search tool) and by Draft outreach for model-written copy. Get one at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys. Without it the pipeline, contacts on file and template drafts still work, Find contact returns a clear 503, and Draft outreach falls back to the built-in template.
